title: calamintha nepeta var. glandulosa
intro: Calamintha nepeta var. glandulosa, commonly known as Nepeta glandulosa or Calamint, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain, and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Calamintha nepeta var. glandulosa include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and act as a natural insect repellent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable herb in traditional medicine.
